name: Cold Joke
description: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by 16% for the next battle.
story:
In Planarcadia, people use "cold jokes" to chill their drinks. But since "cold jokes" haven't been industrialized yet, producing them still heavily depends on the jokester's personal skill. There used to be this "Radical Master of Cold Jokes" who was famous for crafting jokes that went way beyond the physiological limits of the imagenae. Super popular for a while. Then one of his cold jokes actually froze someone to death, so he had no choice but to publicly apologize and disappear from the scene.

"I heard Zhongshan made a batch of cold jokes about 'Fire' recently, perfect balance of hot and cold, really unique texture. But she absolutely refuses to share them with everyone."
"Huh? Why? She's not that stingy, is she?"
"She says she's avoiding the taboo of 'Sparkle.'"
"...What's her problem."
